readOnly: Only admins can change this. You see the current workspace settings.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Switch features on or off for the whole workspace. Disabling a module hides its pages, navigation and widgets — its data is kept.
modules.cascadeDisableBody: {{list}} depend on “{{name}}”. They will be disabled as well.
modules.cascadeEnableBody: “{{name}}” needs {{list}}. They will be enabled as well.
modules.incompatible: This version targets an unsupported API — install an update.
modules.docsHint: Modules are ZIP packages built with the AgentCRM runtime API — see the guide.
modules.noSettings: This module has no settings page.
modules.notLoaded: This module isn't loaded (disabled, safe mode or failed to load).

records.name: Records
records.description: Objects, records, table & kanban views and record pages.

search.name: Search
search.description: ⌘K command palette over records and navigation.

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: Workspace settings, data model, users, import and export.

setup.name: Setup & access
setup.description: Setup wizard, sign-in, data backend, admin hosting and security.

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Home dashboard with KPIs, charts and widgets.

deals.name: Deals & pipelines
deals.description: The deals object, pipelines, kanban board, pipeline reports and dashboard widgets.

reports.name: Reports
reports.description: Pipeline, forecast, won / lost, activity and lead source reports with CSV export.

forms.name: Lead forms
forms.description: Static lead capture forms and inbox ingestion.

tasks.name: Tasks
tasks.description: The tasks page and task overlays.

automations.name: Automations
automations.description: Trigger → conditions → actions workflows and their run log.

integrations.name: Email & calendar
integrations.description: Gmail, Google Calendar and Outlook sync through browser OAuth.

assistant.name: AI assistant
assistant.description: Chat panel driving the CRM with your own Claude API key.

extensions.title: Installed extensions
extensions.description: External modules and themes, stored in your workspace data (encrypted with it) and loaded in every admin.
extensions.drop: Drop an extension ZIP here, or click to choose a file
extensions.dropHint: manifest.json + bundle.js (+ style.css) · up to 4 MB
extensions.uninstallBody: Its code is removed from the workspace for everyone. Data it created and its settings are kept.
extensions.safeMode: Safe mode is on: extensions are not loaded in this tab.

install.title: Install an extension
install.author: Author
install.warningTitle: This code will run with your rights
install.warning: An extension can read and change every record of this workspace, for every user who opens the admin. Only install packages from people you trust.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Colors, shape and branding of the workspace. Changes apply live for everyone.
appearance.accentHint: A full color scale is generated from it.
appearance.fontHint: Google fonts are loaded from fonts.googleapis.com when selected.
appearance.modeHint: For users who never switched light / dark themselves.
appearance.imageHint: PNG, SVG, JPEG, WebP or ICO · up to 200 KB
appearance.imageTooLarge: The image is larger than 200 KB.
appearance.customCssHint: Appended after every other style, for every user. Prefer CSS variables (--acc-500, --srf-100…).
appearance.resetBody: Colors, shape, font and custom CSS go back to the defaults. The logo and favicon are kept.
